notes: Summary: enterprise research portal for buy-side analysts. Primary focus: highly accurate retrieval + reranking for research workflows (citations matter).
Scale: initial index target 35M documents (PDFs + internal research notes). Avg doc size ~12KB. Expect growth to 60M over 18 months.
Architecture preferences: embedding-based ANN retrieval + lightweight BM25 prefilter; neural reranker to improve top-5 precision. Want separation between vector store and reranker compute.
Latency SLOs: retrieval 95th < 200ms; reranking top-5 end-to-end < 120ms (target); interactive analyst flows need sub-300ms token streaming for chat features.
Throughput: baseline 120 qps, peak bursts ~400 qps during earnings cycles; P99 spikes to plan for.
Cost targets: target cost-per-query <$0.03 for retrieval+r rerank in steady state; open to higher during peak if autoscaling handled by dedicated pool.
Security: strict data residency (US-East + EU-West), customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS + Azure Key Vault for EU), full audit logs, SSO/SAML integration, 7-year retention controls for certain datasets.
Why dedicated: predictable latency under peak, required isolation for audit/compliance, easier integration with customer KMS and private networking.
POC success metrics: ingest 10M docs, baseline recall@10 >= 0.85 for annotated test set, reranker latency <= 120ms at 100 qps, cost metrics reported per-1000-queries.
Quotes: 'We need answers that point to the source — citations are non-negotiable.' — Head of Research ops (call 2025-12-02).
Tech notes from SE: embedding dim 1536 preferred (vendor standard), plan to evaluate 8-bit quantized model variants for cost reduction; recommend RBC (Redwood batching + caching) during QPS bursts.
Open questions: vector DB choice (managed vs bring-your-own), exact multi-region KMS workflow, retention/legal export constraints for EU-resident documents.
Links: security FAQ + proposed SOW in drive; metrics template attached to POC folder.
